name: fedimint-react-native-guide-fixtures
description: Compiles every code block the React Native pages promise. The page directories are generated from docs/react-native/*.md by docs/tools/extract_snippets.py and are not committed. The two @fedimint packages link to this repository's own packages, so the pages are checked against the code they will ship with.

scripts.check: npm run extract && npm run typecheck
